_provenance.what: Three REAL closing lines from the 2025 NCAAF season, read on 2026-08-24 through P1.4's own odds join (bakeoff_ncaaf_game.build_clv_staging(min_year=2025), 876 rows / 827 complete) — the identical function scripts/write_ncaaf_serving_store.read_market_lines calls in production.
_provenance.why: The market-AVAILABLE shape has NOTHING to capture. The only NCAAF odds capture scheduled for 2026 is the paid /historical catch-up, which by construction cannot reach a kickoff until it is PAST (P3.1 closeout item 2), so every game on the live wire is status=unavailable. Rather than invent a spread, these are real closes from real kickoffs, fed through the SHIPPING payloads._market() builder by build-ncaaf-degraded.py.
_provenance.chosen_how: One row from each of three spread bands (near pick-em, mid favourite, heavy favourite) so the model-vs-market panel's three shapes are all reachable. The middle row of each band, so the pick is not the extreme.
_provenance.not_a_claim: These lines belong to 2025 games and are attached to 2026 fixtures ONLY to exercise a render. No spec compares them to a model number as though they priced the same game.
